decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith (Plans titled 'existing floor plan' and 'proposed floor plan' and Design and Access Statement, received on 12/11/2012) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The four customer parking bays shall be provided on site before the use hereby approved commences and shall be permanently available for that purpose only thereafter.

Condition : 4 - No activity shall take place on site earlier than 9am or later than 6pm Monday to Friday and no earlier than 9am or later than 2pm on Saturday and not at all on Sundays and public holidays.
Condition : 5 - No works to vehicles shall be carried out other than within the building on the site.
Condition : 6 - Refuse generated on the site shall be stored on site prior to collection and only in the location marked on the approved  'Proposed floor plan'.
description: Change of use from light industrial (Use Class B1) to mechanical repairs and engineering (Use Class B2).
